activationGates: Resolve the active native dialog bug; receive root authorization for this experiment.
Hold all native voice and other shared HaloGen callers. Fresh stack_status must show native sessions 0, gateway active/queued 0, engine busy false/in_flight 0/queued 0. Abort if activity appears.

Verify current controller PID, creation time, executable and command path against server/.local/current.json and fresh CIM; verify original and candidate hashes. Never kill by image name or adopt an unrelated listener.
Use the CLEAN controller.py because its LOCAL directory owns the active run; do not use SCC controller.py, generic Start.ps1, or a profile-generating manage.py start.

Request managed stop, then poll to terminal stopped with clean engine cleanup/recovery and absence of the owned 8731/8840 listeners. The stop command returns before cleanup finishes. Do not start another backend until cleanup is verified.
Use existing memory admission, cleanup and recovery rules. Do not change reserves, context, guards, or unrelated services.

workflow.shell: PowerShell; staged commands below are documentation only and were not executed.
workflow.readyChecks: Require controller phase ready with candidate profile SHA, fresh heartbeat and unchanged 18 GiB reserve; engine/gateway health ready; prompt_cache enabled true/mode 1/nonzero cap_mb; record fresh owned process identities and actual cache configuration without printing credentials.
workflow.probe: Only after readiness, run one root-authorized harmless first-turn speech probe. No name/confirmation/order action. Record model cache counters before/after and per-completion cached token counts, prefill/decode and gateway timing; do not print prompt/response contents. One probe can verify hits if orchestration reuses a prefix, but cannot establish general latency improvement.
workflow.rollback: Hold callers and apply the same fresh idle/ownership gates. Run stopOwnedController; wait for verified stopped/cleanup/recovery and owned listener removal. Run startOriginalAfterVerifiedCleanup. The original profile was never edited.
